description: This file defines a TreeMenu class and a TreeNode class for creating dynamic, collapsible tree menus in web pages. It includes functions for rendering the menu, toggling branches, handling browser compatibility, and managing persistent state via cookies.

classes.name: TreeMenu
classes.description: A class for creating and managing a dynamic tree menu with expandable/collapsible branches.

classes.name: TreeNode
classes.description: A class representing individual nodes within the TreeMenu, supporting nested child nodes and event handling.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a new node to the TreeMenu or TreeNode.

methods.name: preloadImages
methods.description: Preloads branch toggle images for better performance.

methods.name: drawMenu
methods.description: Renders the tree menu HTML structure recursively.

methods.name: writeOutput
methods.description: Outputs the generated menu HTML to the document.

methods.name: toggleBranch
methods.description: Toggles visibility of a branch and updates icons and state.

methods.name: swapImage
methods.description: Swaps plus/minus images for branch toggling.

methods.name: swapIcon
methods.description: Swaps node icons when expanded or collapsed.

methods.name: doesMenu
methods.description: Checks if the browser supports dynamic menus.

methods.name: doesPersistence
methods.description: Checks if the browser supports saving branch states.

methods.name: getLayer
methods.description: Retrieves a DOM element by ID, compatible with different browsers.

methods.name: setExpandedStatusForCookie
methods.description: Saves branch expansion state to cookies.

methods.name: getExpandedStatusFromCookie
methods.description: Retrieves branch expansion state from cookies.

methods.name: saveCookie
methods.description: Saves current branch states into a cookie.

methods.name: loadCookie
methods.description: Loads branch states from a cookie.

methods.name: resetBranches
methods.description: Resets branch states based on saved cookie data.

methods.name: checkParentVisibility
methods.description: Determines if a branch should be visible based on parent states.

methods.name: stringFormat
methods.description: Formats strings with placeholders replaced by arguments.

methods.name: implode
methods.description: Joins array elements into a string with a separator.

methods.name: in_array
methods.description: Checks if an item exists in an array.
